criteria.reason: 明确要求通过环境、关卡和随机种子隔离训练与评估。
criteria.evidence_quote: Separate training and evaluation through clearly defined environments, levels and random seeds.

criteria.reason: 明确要求冻结评估策略模式，包括探索 epsilon。
criteria.evidence_quote: Freeze the evaluation policy mode, including any exploration epsilon.

criteria.reason: 要求使用多个种子并报告均值和波动，而非最佳单次结果。
criteria.evidence_quote: Use multiple seeds and report their mean and variability, not the best run.

criteria.reason: 指标包含回报、成功率、回合长度、约束违反和资源使用。
criteria.evidence_quote: Include return, success, episode length, constraint violations and resource use.

criteria.reason: 要求用标准误或置信/bootstrap 区间量化不确定性。
criteria.evidence_quote: Quantify uncertainty using standard errors or confidence/bootstrap intervals.

criteria.reason: 要求与随机、启发式、已有和无学习基线比较。
criteria.evidence_quote: Compare against suitable random, heuristic, established and no-learning baselines.

criteria.reason: 要求消融所提组件以检验改进的声称原因。
criteria.evidence_quote: Ablate the proposed components to test the claimed cause of improvement.

criteria.reason: 要求记录失败、异常轨迹和分布外行为。
criteria.evidence_quote: Document failures, unusual trajectories and behavior outside the training distribution.
